rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for the cost of something or an action.

example.english: The price of this shirt is a bit high.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 gaa3 cin4 jau5 di1 gou1

rows.note: Use this more formal or written term for a stated price or the cost attached to an action.

example.english: The contract states the price of the service.
example.jyutping: hap6 joek3 lit6 ming4 fuk6 mou6 ge3 gaa3 gaak3

rows.note: Use this for the figurative cost or consequences someone suffers for an action.

example.english: They had to pay the price for what they did.
example.traditional: 佢要為自己嘅所作所為付出代價。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jiu3 wai6 zi6 gei2 ge3 so2 zok3 so2 wai4 fu6 ceot1 doi6 gaa3
